content: In our work, we studied the problem of monolingual and crosslingual clustering, having experimented several directions and methods and the impact they have on the final clustering quality. We described the first system which aggregates news articles into fine-grained story clusters across different languages in a completely online and scalable fashion from a continuous stream.
